principle_violations.reason: The Order class is responsible for both handling item management and maintaining the order status, which violates the Single Responsibility Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the responsibilities of managing order items and managing order status into different classes.

principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor classes depend directly on the concrete Order class, violating the Dependency Inversion Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an interface/abstract class for Order that PaymentProcessor implementations will depend on, allowing for more flexibility and decoupling.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
